verdict.rationale: smolagents documents hierarchical multi-agent orchestration: a manager agent takes subagents through its `managed_agents` argument, with a code example and a dedicated multi-agent example page describing several agents collaborating. missing for 10: peer-to-peer handoffs or crew-style patterns beyond the manager/subagent hierarchy, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-agent runs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can orchestrate multiple agents — handoffs, subagents, or crews — inside one workflow

citations.quote: Then we create a manager agent, and upon initialization we pass our managed agent to it in its `managed_agents` argument.
an agentic system with several agents collaborating to solve problems using the web!
